subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a repaired, rebased branch with live Feishu/CardKit proof, or accept a proof override after their own sanctioned verification?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot produce a live Feishu tenant capture, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked dispatcher tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a user-visible Feishu CardKit change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the rebased behavior through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and has recent Feishu streaming-card history, making them the best available owner for proof override or branch disposition.
